SECTION: 2 — Precondition A decision rule, written before measurement
WHAT_PRECONDITION_A_IS_NOT: it is not the invention of a daughter-identity definition. The daughter is already named by frozen inherited code and FIMRCC01 changes none of it.

WHERE_THE_DAUGHTER_COMES_FROM.named_at: the 1 -> 2 separation, by fmrct01_track.Trigger.observe calling the frozen organisational descent rule DS.descent(prev_cells, prev_comp, cells, comps), which returns the parent index, the daughter index and a descent level.
WHERE_THE_DAUGHTER_COMES_FROM.carried_by: the frozen identity link CC.link between the separation step and the maturation candidate step t_m. Split, merge, tie and out-of-range all terminate a link; none is ever resolved by preference.
WHERE_THE_DAUGHTER_COMES_FROM.checked_at_t_m: the two identities present at t_m must be EXACTLY the pair named at separation. If they are not, parent_comp and daughter_comp are set to None, NO REMOVAL IS APPLIED, and the world is labelled TRIGGERED_IDENTITY_NOT_CARRIED__NO_REMOVAL.

THE_LOCKED_DAUGHTER_ENDPOINT_TO_BE_QUALI.step_1: locate, at t_m, the offline component whose cell set contains the recorded daughter cells. The offline components are rebuilt by tlmr01_offline from the written cell rows; the online component id is NOT used to make this match.
THE_LOCKED_DAUGHTER_ENDPOINT_TO_BE_QUALI.step_2: take the identity-interval id that tlmr01_offline.identity_intervals assigns to that component at t_m.
THE_LOCKED_DAUGHTER_ENDPOINT_TO_BE_QUALI.step_3: follow that interval forward under the frozen link rule only. It ends when the link rule terminates, for a declared reason.
THE_LOCKED_DAUGHTER_ENDPOINT_TO_BE_QUALI.step_4: the endpoint is the frozen DOTC01 COMPLETE_TURNOVER, and its FUNCTIONAL qualification, evaluated STRICTLY INSIDE THAT ONE INTERVAL and strictly after t_m.
THE_LOCKED_DAUGHTER_ENDPOINT_TO_BE_QUALI.contrast_with_the_frozen_TLMR01_endpoint: TLMR01's D stage asks whether ANY identity interval anywhere in the world satisfies the endpoint after the removal. At LAW_C occupancy that is saturated: 2,018 complete intervals across 22 worlds, median 93 per world. The locked daughter endpoint asks the same question of ONE interval.

WHAT_WILL_BE_MEASURED_ON_THE_256_LAW_C_A: N1  worlds triggered, and of those, worlds where the identity was carried to maturation
N2  worlds where a removal was applied (TLMR01 reports 22)
N3  worlds where the recorded daughter cells match EXACTLY ONE offline component at t_m
N4  worlds where that component is assigned exactly one identity-interval id at t_m
N5  the daughter interval's survival: length in steps after t_m, and its termination reason
N6  the endpoint restricted to the daughter interval: COMPLETE and FUNCTIONAL counts
N7  the same endpoint unrestricted (the frozen TLMR01 D stage), for the saturation contrast
N8  the interior IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS rate over all LAW_C episodes, recomputed
N9  worlds where the daughter interval is ambiguous at or after t_m, with the reason

THE_VERDICT_RULE_FIXED_IN_ADVANCE.A1_UNIQUE_LOCALISATION: PASS if N3 == N2 and N4 == N2 — the recorded daughter localises to exactly one offline component and one identity interval in EVERY world that got a removal. Any shortfall is a FAIL and is reported world by world.
THE_VERDICT_RULE_FIXED_IN_ADVANCE.A2_NO_SILENT_TIE: PASS if no world required a tie-break of any kind to localise the daughter. A single tie-break is a FAIL.
THE_VERDICT_RULE_FIXED_IN_ADVANCE.A3_ENDPOINT_IS_NOT_DEGENERATE: PASS if the daughter interval survives at least one step after t_m in every world that got a removal, so the endpoint is askable. Worlds where the daughter is extinct at t_m+1 are reported and counted, not dropped.
THE_VERDICT_RULE_FIXED_IN_ADVANCE.IF_IT_FAILS: the terminal disposition CONFIRMATION_PRECONDITIONS_NOT_MET__LINEAGE_ROUTE_PAUSED is taken and no world of the confirmation runs. The rule is not relaxed to make it pass.

WHAT_THIS_RULE_DELIBERATELY_DOES_NOT_DO: it does not choose the endpoint by which value it produces. A1, A2 and A3 are properties of the identity bookkeeping, not of the turnover outcome.
the saturation contrast N6 vs N7 is a DISCLOSURE computed after the three gates are evaluated. It cannot change the verdict, and this file says so before the numbers exist.
no threshold anywhere in this file is a function of a result.
